nodes.label: Provider State Is Runtime Evidence
nodes.rationale: Provider-native teams, task lists, and session metadata cannot replace Council's durable Mission ledger.

nodes.label: Council Authorship Policy
nodes.rationale: Council-owned work must remain attributable to Cisco and reviewable without AI co-author or maintainer claims.

nodes.label: Repository Authorship Invariant
nodes.rationale: Repository authorship remains with Cisco; an unavailable owner identity is a stop condition rather than grounds to substitute an agent identity.

nodes.label: Exact Identity over Inference
nodes.author: Francisco "Cisco" Garcia
nodes.rationale: Labels, agent names, working directories, and process IDs are eventually ambiguous, so durable provider resources are bound by exact IDs.

nodes.label: Independent Test and Review Gate Pipeline
nodes.author: Francisco "Cisco" Garcia

nodes.label: Local-Only Metrics Posture
nodes.author: Francisco "Cisco" Garcia
nodes.rationale: A local-trust desktop tool should derive metrics from its existing local ledger before considering opt-in telemetry.

nodes.label: Windows Story Gate Exit-Code Defect
nodes.rationale: Running the PowerShell acceptance path on Windows exposed quoting and native-exit propagation bugs that had allowed failing stories to pass.

nodes.label: Agency Agents Router Compatibility Entry Point
Honest PRD Gap Marking
nodes.rationale: Insufficient information must be marked with a specific TODO instead of being fabricated.

nodes.label: Host-Owned Department Readiness Gate
nodes.rationale: A Department Head may recommend readiness, but only the host gate decides it after validating evidence for every criterion.

nodes.label: Council Lead Main-Session Requirement
nodes.rationale: Independent advisors require separate contexts created by the council-lead main session; a single-context role-play is not a valid Council.

nodes.label: Risk-Aware Promotion Policy
nodes.rationale: Destructive or high-impact changes require a review branch and explicit approval, while even low-risk direct-main work remains gated.

nodes.label: Host-Owned Capability Policy
nodes.rationale: Imported role metadata can narrow expertise but cannot grant permissions, tools, credentials, memory, or approval authority.

nodes.label: Builder Test Ownership Boundary
nodes.rationale: The implementer may use tests as feedback but cannot author or weaken them or claim final acceptance.

nodes.label: Anonymous Peer Review and Chairman Handoff
Department Ready Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Department readiness is only a recommendation until the Council host independently validates the evidence and criteria.

hyperedges.label: Separated Implementation Test and Review Authority
